Good to know

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

Do you coach sprint, Olympic, 70.3 and Ironman?

Yes. Our triathlon coaching covers all disciplines of triathlon from Sprint to Ironman, for first-timers and experienced age-groupers alike.

Do you coach all three disciplines?

Yes. Your plan balances swim, bike and run every week, with the bike built on Matteo’s professional cycling background: power, pacing and race strategy.

How many hours do I need to train?

It depends on your training availability. Your plan is built around the time you have, so every session counts.

Which platform do you use?

Your plan is delivered in TrainingPeaks or Vekta and syncs to Garmin, Wahoo, Zwift and more.

Do you offer a student discount?

Yes. Underage, Juniors & U23 avail of a 20% student discount for all packages.

Can I work 1-to-1 with a sports nutritionist?

Yes. Every package includes access to our sports nutritionist, Marine Lenehan (MSc, WorldTour professional cyclist). You can also add nutrition coaching with her: your daily macros and carbs per hour in the same calendar as your training, food diary reviews and a race fuelling plan for swim, bike and run. See how it works.

Triathlon coaching · Sprint to Ironman

WHY CHOOSE OUR TRIATHLON COACHING?

Whether you’re training for your first sprint triathlon or aiming for a personal best in Ironman, Cigala Cycling Coaching provides the structured, personalised support you need to reach your full potential.

See our triathlon coaching packagesBook a free consultation
Online triathlon coaching

SWIM, BIKE, RUN: ONE PLAN

Led by former professional cyclist and elite-level coach Matteo Cigala, our triathlon coaching program blends world-class cycling expertise with proven endurance training principles to help athletes get fitter, faster, and more confident across all three disciplines.

Based in Ireland and coaching athletes worldwide, we plan your three disciplines together, around your work, family and race calendar, so you arrive at the start line fit, fresh and confident.

Why choose us

WHAT YOU GET

  • Personalised Training Plans

    Your plan is tailored to your schedule, fitness level, goals, and race calendar — no generic templates, ever.

  • Expert Cycling Foundation

    Improve your strongest discipline or fix your weakest. With Matteo’s pro cycling background, you get unmatched guidance on power, pacing, and race strategy.

  • Full Triathlon Approach

    We support all three disciplines — swim, bike, run — with balanced weekly programming and progression.

  • Data-Driven Coaching

    Training is structured around: power and heart-rate metrics; periodisation, fueling strategy, recovery optimisation.

  • Dedicated Support

    Regular check-ins, feedback on workouts, open communication, and guidance to keep you accountable and progressing.

  • For All Levels

    From beginners to advanced age-group or pro athletes — everyone is welcome and supported.

  • Testing & Zones

    Test protocols (CP, FTP, FTHR or INSCYD) and adaptive training zones that change as you get fitter.

  • Nutrition & Mental Coach

    Access to work 1-to-1 with our sports nutritionist, Marine Lenehan, and our mental coach, with daily carb recommendations on Advanced and Premium.

Yes. Your plan balances swim, bike and run every week, with the bike built on Matteo’s professional cycling background: power, pacing and race strategy.

It depends on your training availability. Your plan is built around the time you have, so every session counts.

Your plan is delivered in TrainingPeaks or Vekta and syncs to Garmin, Wahoo, Zwift and more.

Yes. Underage, Juniors & U23 avail of a 20% student discount for all packages.
